from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RevenueEntry(BaseModel):
    """A revenue figure extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company issuing the report")
    revenue_amount: float | None = Field(description="Numerical value of revenue as reported in the text")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date or description")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial filing (e.g., 10-Q, 10-K)")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item name in the statement (e.g., 'Total Revenues')")
    source_quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim text containing the revenue figure and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_revenue_reports: list[RevenueEntry]
